beats.intro: Unit eight, chapter forty-five. [[sub]]A function is a rule that gives exactly one output for each input.
beats.relation: A relation is a set of ordered pairs: each pair matches an input with an output. [[pairs]]Here's a relation with four pairs. [[dom]]The set of all inputs, the x-values, is the domain: negative two, zero, one, and four. [[ran]]The set of all outputs, the y-values, is the range: one, three, and six. Three appears twice, but a set lists it once. [[map]]A mapping diagram draws an arrow from each input to its output.
beats.function: A function is a special relation: [[one]]every input has exactly one output. [[check]]In this diagram, each input sends out a single arrow, so the relation is a function. [[share]]Two inputs may share an output. Zero and one both go to three, and that's fine. [[bad]]Now look at this relation. [[split]]The input three goes to both one and five. One input, two outputs: [[not]]this relation is not a function.
beats.q1: Quick check. Find the relation that is not a function.
beats.forms: In a function, the output depends on the input. [[vars]]The input x is the independent variable, and the output y is the dependent variable. [[rule]]Take the rule: y is twice x. [[table]]You can show it as a table, [[graph]]or as points on a graph. [[same]]Words, table, diagram, or graph: they're four views of the same function.
beats.vlt: On a graph, the vertical line test checks for a function. [[pts]]Plot the relation. [[sweep]]Slide a vertical line across the plane. [[pass]]If it never touches more than one point at a time, every x has only one y: the relation is a function. [[other]]Try a second relation. [[hit]]At x equals negative five, the line touches two points. [[fail]]Two y-values for one x: it fails the test, so it's not a function.
beats.curves: The test works on curves too. [[para]]This U-shaped curve passes: any vertical line crosses it once. [[circ]]A circle fails: most vertical lines cross it twice. [[side]]A U turned on its side fails too. [[rule]]If any vertical line crosses the graph more than once, it's not a function.
beats.q2: Quick check. Use the vertical line test.
beats.wrap: To sum up. [[w1]]A relation is a set of ordered pairs; its inputs form the domain and its outputs form the range. [[w2]]In a function, each input has exactly one output. Outputs may repeat; inputs may not. [[w3]]On a graph, use the vertical line test. [[end]]Now try the chapter practice.
